category: Open-Source Backup, Snapshot Deduplication & Disaster Recovery Engines

repos.name: Restic
repos.description: Fast, secure, efficient backup program using content-defined chunking deduplication and authenticated encryption
highlights: Cryptographically secure end-to-end client-side encryption using AES-256 in CTR mode and Poly1305-AES
Direct native integration with cloud backends: AWS S3, MinIO, Wasabi, Backblaze B2, SFTP, and REST server
Single static Go binary requiring zero server daemons or database infrastructure

repos.name: Kopia
repos.description: Cross-platform fast, incremental backups with client-side encryption, compression, and deduplication
highlights: Built-in content-addressable storage with ZSTD compression and snapshot policy retention rules
Both high-velocity CLI and cross-platform native GUI for Windows, macOS, and Linux desktop fleets
Native multi-user repository server mode with TLS authentication and granular ACLs

repos.name: BorgBackup
repos.description: Deduplicating archiver with compression, authenticated encryption, and remote repository caching
highlights: Gold standard chunk-based deduplication reducing storage footprints by 85-95%
Authenticated 256-bit encryption with optional LZ4, ZSTD, and LZMA compression algorithms
FUSE filesystem mounting allowing direct browsing of historical snapshots as standard directories
